responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend utility that resolves the active source-language edition from session compile options into the lightweight Rust::Edition enum used elsewhere in the util layer. This file belongs to frontend configuration handling and provides the concrete bridge from Session::get_instance().options.get_edition() and CompileOptions::Edition values to the local edition abstraction, so code that only needs edition-dependent behavior can query the selected 2015/2018/2021 mode without depending directly on the heavier session-manager interfaces.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line implementation of the header-declared get_rust_edition() query, performing the runtime conversion from Session/CompileOptions values in rust-session-manager.h to the local Rust::Edition enum. Unlike rust-edition.h, it does not introduce the abstraction interface; it supplies the session-dependent mapping logic behind it.
